firm.name: Pacific Risk Advisors Ltd
firm.tagline: Local knowledge. Regional understanding. Global foresight.
firm.summary: ESG advisors to investors, multinationals and growing businesses worldwide. Pacific Risk Advisors combines local knowledge in every market, deep regional understanding, and global foresight on where regulation and investor expectations are heading. The result is practical advice that protects people, the environment and your returns.
firm.position: PRA bridges the gap between ESG strategy, operational and technical issues and maximising investor returns.
firm.vision: To be the trusted ESG advisor that brings global foresight to ESG risk, helping investors and businesses worldwide anticipate change and turn risk into resilience, compliance and lasting value.

why_pra.title: Local knowledge, global reach
why_pra.detail: Headquartered in Hong Kong, PRA is a long-standing associate of the Inogen Alliance, a global network of independent environmental and sustainability consultancies. Through the alliance PRA draws on around 6,000 advisors in 200 offices, covering more than 150 countries. You get one point of contact, and local experts who know the regulations, culture and language on the ground.

why_pra.title: Regional understanding
why_pra.detail: PRA's roots are in Asia-Pacific. Its reach covers Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Africa.

why_pra.title: Global foresight
why_pra.detail: PRA tracks where standards and expectations are going: IFC, ADB, EBRD, DFC, DFAT, the Equator Principles, the ILO and new disclosure and due diligence laws. That means you are ready before requirements arrive.

why_pra.title: Advisors, not box-tickers
why_pra.detail: PRA links ESG performance to strategy, operations and value, so compliance becomes a business advantage.

why_pra.title: One partner, across the life cycle
why_pra.detail: From due diligence and strategy to management systems, implementation, reporting and exit, PRA stays with you across the whole life cycle.

why_pra.title: Advice backed by technology
why_pra.detail: PRA's sister company, Clean Future Technologies Ltd (CFT), provides ESG reporting and analysis platforms. You get expert advice and the digital tools to measure, manage and report your performance.

values.name: Pragmatism

values.name: Foresight
values.detail: Preparing you for tomorrow's standards today.

values.name: Partnership
values.detail: Building your capability and long-term relationships.

values.name: Impact
values.detail: Measurable benefits for people, the environment and value.

operating_model.principle: Advisors lead every engagement. AI agents support them.

agents.name: Engagement memory
agents.does: Holds PRA's past proposals, budgets and project records as structured records, each figure traced to its source file.
agents.client_benefit: Your brief is matched to comparable past work, so scope, team and fee rest on PRA's real experience.

agents.name: Proposal support
agents.does: Reads your terms of reference in full and prepares a first draft of scope, programme and budget for the advisor.
agents.client_benefit: A scoped proposal reaches you sooner, with the open questions listed.

agents.name: Document review
agents.does: Reads data room files in full, including scans and other languages, with translation.
agents.client_benefit: Nothing goes unread because it was long, scanned or in another language.

agents.name: Site visit records
agents.does: Logs photos, notes and observations to the engagement on the day they are taken.
agents.client_benefit: Findings are written up from a complete record of the visit.

safeguards.title: A named advisor signs every deliverable
safeguards.detail: Agents draft. PRA advisors review, decide and put their name to the work.

safeguards.title: Nothing leaves PRA without approval
safeguards.detail: Proposals, reports and messages wait until a person releases them.

safeguards.title: Every figure cites its source
safeguards.detail: Each number and finding traces to the file it came from. Gaps are flagged, never filled by guesswork.

safeguards.title: Your files stay under PRA's control
safeguards.detail: Client documents sit on PRA's own systems. When a model reads a document it does so under commercial terms that bar training on it.

safeguards.title: Public and confidential are kept apart
safeguards.detail: The assistant on this site sees published information only. Client work is never within its reach.

faqs.a: PRA advises investors, multinationals and growing businesses on ESG risk. The work runs from ESG strategy and due diligence to compliance audits, management systems, climate and decarbonisation, social and human rights safeguarding, reporting, technical services, and capacity building and executive coaching. One partner stays with you from due diligence to exit.

faqs.q: We are acquiring a business overseas. What would you cover?
faqs.a: Transaction services cover ESG due diligence for international M&A, red-flag reviews, action plans and post-deal support. PRA gives you one point of contact and brings in local experts who know the regulations, culture and language in the target's market.

faqs.q: Which standards do you work to?
faqs.a: PRA tracks IFC, ADB, EBRD, DFC, DFAT, the Equator Principles and the ILO, along with new disclosure and due diligence laws. Compliance work includes ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.

PRA is headquartered in Hong Kong with roots in Asia-Pacific, and its reach covers Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Africa. As a long-standing associate of the Inogen Alliance, PRA draws on around 6,000 advisors in 200 offices, covering more than 150 countries. PRA has its own advisors in 38 countries and territories and offices in Hong Kong and Bangkok.

faqs.q: What is an ESMS, and do you build them?
faqs.a: An Environmental and Social Management System is the set of policies, procedures and responsibilities an organisation uses to manage E&S risk. PRA builds them for funds, banks and companies, aligned with IFC, development finance institution and investor standards.

faqs.q: Do you carry out compliance audits?
faqs.a: Yes. ESG compliance and audits covers environmental, health and safety compliance audits, ISO 14001 and 45001 management systems, fire and life safety, and regulatory registers.
Yes. Climate and decarbonisation covers climate risk and scenario analysis, GHG footprinting, transition planning and climate value-at-risk, with PRA's partner Intensel.

faqs.q: Can you help us report ESG data?
faqs.a: Yes. PRA's sister company, Clean Future Technologies Ltd (CFT), provides ESG reporting and analysis platforms. They help you collect, analyse and report ESG data across your operations, portfolio or supply chain. PRA's advisors set up the right metrics.

faqs.q: Do you cover human rights and supply chains?
faqs.a: Yes. Social, human rights and safeguarding covers labour and supply-chain due diligence, modern slavery, child protection and PSEAH, and community and land issues.
PRA is introducing AI agents to support its advisors with reading, searching, drafting and record-keeping. Advisors do the scoping, the site work and the judgement, and sign every deliverable.

faqs.q: Is my data used to train AI models?
faqs.a: No. Client documents sit on PRA's own systems. When a model reads a document it does so under commercial terms that bar training on it. The assistant on this site sees published information only.

faqs.q: Can my AI assistant talk to PRA directly?
faqs.a: Yes. PRA runs a Model Context Protocol server. Point your assistant at the endpoint and it can look up PRA's services and reach, and send an enquiry on your behalf.
Talk to us about your ESG risks. Use the form on this page, email enquiries@pacificriskadvisors.com, or call +852 2603 6690. Fees depend on scope and are quoted per engagement.
PRA was founded in 2005 by James Pearson, its Chief Executive Officer. He has advised on environmental and social risk in Asia since 1992, and in Europe from 1988.

faqs.q: Do you offer ESG training or executive coaching?
faqs.a: Yes. PRA builds ESG capability at every level of an organisation. For boards and senior executives, one-to-one coaching and briefings on ESG risk, investor expectations and incoming regulation. For management and operating teams, workshops and training programmes tailored to the sector and the standards it works to. For institutions, training of trainers, so the knowledge stays with its people.
